note: RIG 9 adversarial input and trust-boundary discovery. Tests assert safe behavior and FAIL (when ADVERSARIAL=1) if fabricated input yields unauthorized mint, fee credit, or RAC. Live Verifier on Base was checked read-only: configurationFinalized=true, deployer=0, 15 readers registered (Solana none), only Base ETH has a usable scheduled price ($2392.22). Full addresses omitted.

findings.damage_potential: About 310.96 VCLM minted per forged 0.01 ETH-equivalent lock at $2392 (day-0 emission). Arbitrary volume by repeating with new lockIds.
findings.description: Ethereum reader accepts a fully fabricated header, receipt trie, account trie and storage trie. verifyFinality only checks self-consistency of claimed chainId/hash/height against keccak(headerRlp). No settled-history anchor.
findings.evidence: ADVERSARIAL=1 FINDING ADV-01 minted 310.96 VCLM. Cross-ref AG-01.
findings.live_or_latent: LIVE reader path on finalized Verifier (Ethereum reader registered). Mint/RAC also need a usable scheduled price for Ethereum ETH (currently unused); once the poster writes that price, forgery mints on the live Verifier without app involvement.

pass_cases.description: Base rejects wrong lockId in proof
Ticker USDC cannot substitute for token address / ETH_ID
Arbitrum lock cannot authenticate as Ethereum (wrong lock/env)
Unindexed Base ERC20 cannot mint as ETH
CVL clone at another address rejected (log emitter)
Package recipient mismatch vs storage-proven recipient
Alternate Base proof encoding cannot double-mint
Genuine Ethereum mainnet header + non-lock receipt cannot extractFacts as lock
XRPL-style asset id is not ETH_ID
